newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Meredith EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Meredith EPS view raised.

text.p: Gruntal & Co Inc on Wednesday said analyst Rita Benson raised her fiscal 1998 earnings estimate for Meredith Corp to $1.36 a share from $1.33.
--Gruntal also raised its 12-month price target for the stock to $34 from $33. Meredith shares were 11/16 higher at 28-3/8 early Wednesday afternoon.

--Benson said the new target for the year ending June 30, 1998, reflected a "brighter-than-anticipated outlook" for the publishing and broadcasting company, which warrants a higher trading multiple than the current 9.4 times.
--She said the publishing outlook is "very bright" for the first half of 1998 and that the broadcast group should drive cash-flow growth in the coming year.
--"Significant growth in the broadcast segment highlighted the company's results and it should continue to drive profit growth in fiscal 1998," she wrote.

"We believe the company is set to turn in healthy increases in revenue (17 percent) and operating profit (30 percent) in the coming year (fiscal 1998) despite the dilutive effects of acquisitions, and we maintain our Strong Buy rating," she wrote.
Meredith on Tuesday reported earnings of $0.36 per share for the fourth quarter ended June 30, versus $0.28 in the year-earlier period.
